top_signals.title: Asian Stocks to Fall as Tech Rout Fuels AI Fears: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks were set to fall, tracking Friday’s sharp Wall Street selloff as a rout in technology shares deepened concerns that a rally in artificial intelligence may have gone too far.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
